WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
sales_dedup AS (
    SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY etl_loaded_at, sales_line_id) = 1
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku, p.category AS cat_then,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM sales_dedup f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND (f.channel_code IS DISTINCT FROM 'WB' OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL OR s.store_id <> 900)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, p.category, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT cp.category AS as_is_category, 
       round(SUM(n.net_sales),2) AS net_sales, round(SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost),2) AS gross_margin,
       round(100.0*SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost)/SUM(n.net_sales),2) AS gm_pct,
       round(SUM(CASE WHEN n.cat_then=cp.category THEN n.net_sales END),2) AS ns_aswas_same_cat,
       count(*) AS nlines
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=6 AND cp.category IN ('Garden','Electrical')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
sales_dedup AS (
    SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY etl_loaded_at, sales_line_id) = 1
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost,
           (s.store_id = 900 AND w.web_order_id IS NULL) AS undispatched_web
    FROM sales_dedup f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned, false
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT CASE WHEN cp.subcategory = 'Outdoor Lighting' THEN 'Electrical' ELSE cp.category END AS cat_fixed,
       (cp.subcategory = 'Outdoor Lighting' AND cp.category = 'Garden') AS stranded_sku,
       n.undispatched_web,
       round(SUM(n.net_sales),2) AS net_sales, round(SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost),2) AS gross_margin, count(*) AS nlines
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=6 AND (cp.category IN ('Garden','Electrical'))
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3
